name: New Moon Illuminated Shop Sign
summary: Wall-mounted dark-green shop sign with a brass cornice, three warm downlights, a luminous filigree crescent and raised gold serif lettering.
description: A shallow wall sign with a mitred frame, perforated sloping soffit, black-steel backing and four keyhole mounting straps. Its individually removable mesh letters are set in STIX Two Text.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Deterministic bpy profile meshes, converted type outlines, analytic filigree and embedded procedural images. The far artwork is an orthographic colour bake of the near relief.
origin: Root at [0, 0, 0], horizontally centred on the wall plane at the lower edge. All geometry projects forward.
material_notes: Opaque green matte enamel (roughness 0.80), brushed metallic brass (procedural roughness around 0.35), polished brass, pale-gold metallic cap faces, honey opal, warm cream emission and blackened steel. The far graphics use a masked baked material.

font.runtime: Converted to seven letter meshes in the near LOD and pixels in the far LOD.

reference.note: Owner-supplied image used as visual guidance only.

near.switch: Use within about 15 m or for oblique close-ups.

far.switch: Suggested beyond 15 m. One embedded 1024 × 256 RGBA bake spans two independently selectable flat graphic quads. The consuming scene selects this file.

accuracy_notes: The botanical tracery and STIX serifs are interpretations of the reference. The distance threshold is guidance for the consuming scene. Real-time halo and reflected illumination depend on the renderer.

attribution.credit: Original procedural sign geometry, textures and filigree. Owner-supplied visual reference.
